SELECT tblmedicalinfos.Age, tblpatients.Surname, tblpatients.OtherNames, tblpatients.Sex, tblpatients.Residence, tblpatients.PostalAddress, tblpatients.CityTown, tblpatients.InPatientNo, tblpatients.Telephone1, tblmedinfo.IsReferal, tblmedinfo.ReferalReason, tblmedinfo.IsAlive, tbladmissions.AdmissionDateTime, tbladmissions.DischargeDateTime, tbldischargesummary.Diagnosis, tbldischargesummary.DischargePrescription, tbldischargesummary.TreatmentGiven, tbldischargesummary.Comments, tbldischargesummary.Admittedduration FROM tblmedicalinfos INNER JOIN tblmedinfo ON tblmedicalinfos.VisitID = tblmedinfo.VisitID INNER JOIN tblpatients ON tblmedicalinfos.PatientID = tblpatients.PatientID INNER JOIN tbladmissions ON tblmedicalinfos.VisitID = tbladmissions.VisitID INNER JOIN tbldischargesummary ON tbladmissions.AdmissionID = tbldischargesummary.AdmissionID WHERE (tbladmissions.AdmissionDateTime>=@fromDate) AND (tbladmissions.AdmissionDateTime <=@toDate)

SELECT tblhospitalinfo.Name AS HospitalName, tblconsultants.Alias AS ConsultantAlias, tblconsultants.Surname, tblconsultants.MobileNo1, tblsystemusers.Username AS PreparedBy, tblconsultantbills.ConsultantBillID, tblconsultantbills.ConsultantID, tblconsultantbills.PreparedBySysUID, tblconsultantbills.DateTimeCreated, tblconsultantbills.TotalAmount, tblconsultantbills.HospitalDeduction, tblconsultantbills.NetAmount, tblconsultantbills.IsCleared, tblconsultantbills.TotalAmountPaid FROM tblconsultantbills INNER JOIN tblconsultants ON tblconsultantbills.ConsultantID = tblconsultants.ConsultantID, tblhospitalinfo, tblsystemusers where(tblconsultantbills.ConsultantID=@consultantID)

SELECT tblhospitalinfo.HospitalInfoID, tblhospitalinfo.Name, tblhospitalinfo.LetterHead, tblhospitalinfo.Logo, tblmedicalinfos.Age, tblmedicalinfos.VisitDateTime, tblpatients.Surname, tblpatients.OtherNames, tblpatients.Sex, tblpatients.DateOfBirth, tblpatients.ThirdName, tbltbscreening.IsUnder5, tbltbscreening.IsCough, tbltbscreening.IsLossWeight, tbltbscreening.IsNightSweats, tbltbscreening.IsFever, tbltbscreening.IsReducedPlay, tblmedicalinfos.Doctor, tbltbscreening.TBScreeningID, tbltbscreening.IsPositive FROM tblpatients INNER JOIN tblmedicalinfos ON tblpatients.PatientID = tblmedicalinfos.PatientID INNER JOIN tbltbscreening ON tblmedicalinfos.VisitID = tbltbscreening.VisitID, tblhospitalinfo WHERE (tblmedicalinfos.VisitDateTime >= @fromDateTime) AND (tblmedicalinfos.VisitDateTime <= @toDateTime)
